title: Enforcement Decree of the Saemaul Undong Organization Promotion Act
full_text:
Article 1 (Purpose)
The purpose of this Decree is to prescribe matters delegated by the Saemaul Undong Organization Promotion Act and matters necessary for its implementation.

Article 2 Deleted. <August 13, 2012>

Article 3 (Requests for Contributions)
To receive a contribution from the Government pursuant to Article 3 (1) of the Saemaul Undong Organization Promotion Act (hereinafter referred to as the "Act"), a Saemaul Undong organization shall submit a request for a contribution, accompanied by the following documents, to the competent Minister by April 30 each year: <Amended on January 5, 2021>
1. A business plan for the following year;
2. A projected income statement and a projected statement of financial position for the following year;
3. Other documents necessary to clarify the details of the request for a contribution.

Article 4 (Notification of Finalization of Budgets)
When the budget for contributions has been finalized, the competent Minister shall notify the relevant Saemaul Undong organization thereof.

Article 5 (Applications for Payment of Contributions)
To receive payment of a contribution, a Saemaul Undong organization shall submit an application for payment of a contribution, accompanied by quarterly business plans and quarterly budget execution plans, to the competent Minister.

Article 6 (Management of Reserve Funds)
Reserve funds under Article 3 (3) of the Act shall be managed in a separately established account, distinct from other expenses.

Article 7 (Treatment of Surpluses)
Where a surplus arises from the settlement of accounts for a fiscal year, a Saemaul Undong organization shall apply it to cover losses carried forward and carry the remainder forward to the following year or transfer it to the reserve fund.

Article 8 (Scope of Leasing, etc. of State and Public Property)
(1) The Saemaul Undong organizations to which the State or a local government may lease or transfer State or public property free of charge, or allow its use and the earning of profits from it free of charge, pursuant to Article 4 of the Act shall be the Korea Saemaul Undong Center, the Central Council of Saemaul Leaders, the Central Federation of Saemaul Women's Associations, and the Central Council for Saemaul Undong in Workplaces and Factories.
(2) Details concerning the lease, transfer, or use and earning of profits from State or public property free of charge under paragraph (1) shall be governed by a contract between the head of a central government agency under Article 6 of the National Finance Act (hereinafter referred to as the "head of a central government agency") or the head of a local government and the Saemaul Undong organization.
(3) Where a Saemaul Undong organization uses property leased to it free of charge or made available for its use and earning of profits free of charge pursuant to Article 4 of the Act for a purpose other than the intended purpose, the head of a central government agency or the head of a local government may cancel the contract or permission. The same shall apply where property transferred to the organization is used for a purpose other than the intended purpose within 10 years.
(4) Where the head of a central government agency or the head of a local government intends to lease or transfer State or public property free of charge, or allow its use and the earning of profits from it free of charge, pursuant to Article 4 of the Act, the head shall consult with the authority having overall control of the relevant property.

Article 9 (Application Mutatis Mutandis of the State Property Act, etc.)
With respect to matters other than those prescribed in this Decree concerning the lease, transfer, or use and earning of profits from State or public property free of charge under Article 4 of the Act, the relevant provisions of the State Property Act or the Public Property and Commodity Management Act shall apply mutatis mutandis.

Article 10 (Requests for Secondment of Saemaul Undong Personnel)
(1) When requesting the secondment of Saemaul Undong personnel pursuant to Article 6 (1) of the Act, the Korea Saemaul Undong Center shall submit to the head of the relevant institution, corporation, or organization, through the Minister of the Interior and Safety, a request for secondment stating the affiliation, rank, name, and other personal particulars of the person whose secondment is sought. <Amended on March 23, 2013; November 19, 2014; July 26, 2017>
(2) The Minister of the Interior and Safety shall attach an opinion to the request for secondment under paragraph (1) and forward it to the head of the relevant institution, corporation, or organization. <Amended on March 23, 2013; November 19, 2014; July 26, 2017>

Article 11 (Remuneration, etc. of Seconded Persons)
The period of secondment, remuneration, etc. of a person seconded to the Korea Saemaul Undong Center pursuant to Article 6 of the Act shall be determined through consultation between the institution, corporation, or organization seconding the Saemaul Undong personnel and the Korea Saemaul Undong Center: Provided, That where relevant statutes and regulations contain special provisions concerning the secondment of public officials, those provisions shall apply.

Article 12 (Service of Seconded Persons)
A person seconded to the Korea Saemaul Undong Center shall serve during the period of secondment as prescribed by the Korea Saemaul Undong Center and shall be subject to the direction and supervision of the President of the Korea Saemaul Undong Center.

Article 13 (Submission of Budget Documents, etc.)
(1) A Saemaul Undong organization shall prepare its business plan under Article 9 of the Act by dividing it into objectives, policies, major projects, and required budget.
(2) When modifying the contents of major projects in the business plan under paragraph (1), the organization shall report to the competent Minister, specifically stating the reasons for and details of the modification.

Article 14 (Reporting of Settlement of Accounts)
In addition to business performance results, a report on the settlement of revenue and expenditure under Article 10 of the Act shall be accompanied by the following documents: <Amended on January 5, 2021>
1. An income statement and a statement of financial position for the relevant year;
2. Other materials that can clarify the details of the settlement of accounts.

Article 15 (Provisions Applicable Mutatis Mutandis)
Where a Saemaul Undong organization receives contributions from the head of a central government agency other than the competent Minister or from the head of a local government, Articles 3 through 5, 13, and 14 shall apply mutatis mutandis. In such cases, "competent Minister" shall be construed as "head of the relevant central government agency or head of a local government."

ADDENDUM <Presidential Decree No. 10226, March 2, 1981>
This Decree shall enter into force on the date of its promulgation.
